#### `def hook(hook_api)` (Línea 54)
- **Propósito:** SQLAlchemy 0.9 introduced the decorator 'util.dependencies'.  This decorator does imports. E.g.:

        @util.dependencies("sqlalchemy.sql.schema")

This hook scans for included SQLAlchemy modules and then scans those modules for any util.dependencies and marks
those modules as hidden imports.
- **Firma:** `def hook(hook_api)`
- **Retorno / Efectos:** Consulta código fuente.
